name: Soledad Marcial
office: City of Santa Monica, Member of the Rent Control Board

items.text: Soledad Marcial's campaign says she has worked for many years to fight against evictions and displacement. Her top priority is to maintain policies that protect people in rent-controlled units and adapt new policies that benefit renters. She pledges to enforce the rent control law and support amendments that benefit renters. She states she will be a fair and impartial decision-maker who can work effectively with tenants and owners.
